rows.en: ＠０１０＿００１＊Narusawa＊Hey, how are you doing?＝＠０１０＿００２I have a proposal for you today.＝＠０１０＿００３It's about your training￥from here on...
＠０１０＿００４＊Narusawa＊How'd you like to try it with￥the others? Not just training on￥your own, but training together.＝＠０１０＿００５Whoever's best at a subject acts￥as coach and teaches the rest.
＊Narusawa＊＠０１０＿００６Of course, it's not mandatory.￥Everyone has their own pace.＝＠０１０＿００７But there's a lot to be gained￥from it.
＠０１０＿００８＊Narusawa＊I'm about to pass this idea on￥to everyone.＝＠０１０＿００９You understand why we put￥everyone in the same facility...＝＠０１０＿０１０I think you can help the others￥see it too.
